segments.name: Architectural Metals
segments.description: Designs, engineers, fabricates and finishes aluminum window and façade systems for non-residential construction.
segments.evidence: The Architectural Metals Segment designs, engineers, fabricates and finishes aluminum window, curtainwall, storefront and entrance systems used primarily in non-residential construction.

segments.name: Architectural Services
segments.description: Integrates technical services, project management and field installation to design, engineer and install architectural curtainwall and façade systems.
segments.evidence: The Architectural Services Segment integrates technical services, project management, and field installation services to design, engineer, fabricate, and install architectural curtainwall and other façade-related systems used primarily in non-residential construction.

segments.name: Architectural Glass
segments.description: Cuts, treats, coats and fabricates high-performance glass used in custom window and wall systems for non-residential buildings.
segments.evidence: The Architectural Glass Segment cuts, treats, coats and fabricates high-performance glass used in custom window and wall systems used primarily in non-residential buildings.

segments.name: Performance Surfaces
segments.description: Develops and manufactures high-performance coated materials for wall decor, displays, architectural interiors and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: The Performance Surfaces Segment develops and manufactures high-performance coated materials for a variety of applications, including wall decor, museums, graphic design, digital displays, architectural interiors, and industrial flooring.

revenueModel.text: Customers including glazing subcontractors, general contractors, architects and building owners purchase architectural products and services for non-residential construction projects.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are mainly glazing subcontractors and general contractors, with project design being influenced by architects and building owners.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, Performance Surfaces Segment acquired UW Interco, LLC (UW Solutions), which was successfully integrated in fiscal 2026.
changes.evidence: The Performance Surfaces Segment successfully integrated the UW Interco, LLC (UW Solutions), acquired in late fiscal 2025, and the business delivered upon the first-year financial targets of $100 million in revenue and adjusted EBITDA margin of at least 20%.
